name: Clipboard
description: A private history of what you copy: search it, pin favorites, paste again.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Keeps a private history of what you copy, so you can find and paste it again.
rules: Search the history, pin favourites so they stay, and click an item to copy or paste it.
It's stored only on your Mac, and the menu bar icon shows while it's recording.
Record your own shortcut below to open it from anywhere.
